question: Who won the Champions of the Earth Award, 2024, the UN’s highest environmental recognition?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Madhav Gadgil**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• **Madhav Gadgil**, an eminent Indian ecologist, is renowned for his contributions to environmental conservation and sustainable development.
 
• He has been associated with the formulation of the **Western Ghats Ecology Expert Panel (WGEEP)**, which provided groundbreaking recommendations for the preservation of the ecologically sensitive Western Ghats region.
 
• His work emphasizes the importance of community-based conservation and the integration of traditional knowledge with scientific research.
 
• Madhav Gadgil's recognition with the **Champions of the Earth Award**, the UN's highest environmental honor, highlights his relentless efforts toward ecological sustainability.
 
• The award celebrates individuals who have made exceptional contributions to environmental protection and sustainable development globally.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Champions of the Earth Award:**

 
 
• It is the United Nations' flagship environmental award presented by the United Nations Environment Programme (UNEP).
 
• The award recognizes pioneers in environmental conservation, sustainable development, and climate action.
 
• It is conferred annually in various categories, including Policy Leadership, Science and Innovation, Entrepreneurial Vision, and Lifetime Achievement.
 
 
 
• **Western Ghats Ecology Expert Panel (WGEEP):**
 
 
• Also known as the Gadgil Committee, it was established to assess and recommend measures for the conservation of the Western Ghats, a UNESCO World Heritage site.
 
• The panel proposed a classification of zones based on ecological sensitivity and advocated community participation in decision-making.
 
• Its recommendations sparked significant debates on balancing development and conservation in India.
 
 
 
• **Ecological Conservation:**
 
 
• Ecological conservation involves the protection and sustainable management of ecosystems and biodiversity.
 
• It emphasizes minimizing human impact and promoting practices that restore and preserve natural habitats.
 
• Community engagement and traditional ecological knowledge are crucial components of successful conservation efforts.
 
 
 
• **Sustainable Development:**
 
 
• Defined as development that meets the needs of the present without compromising the ability of future generations to meet their own needs.
 
• It integrates economic, social, and environmental dimensions to ensure long-term viability.
 
• The concept is central to global efforts to combat climate change and environmental degradation.
